vendor_highlights: Released gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17, a Gemini preview model optimized for price-performance and adaptive thinking.

changelog.text:
*   **Gemini 2.5 Flash deprecation**:
  [`gemini-2.5-flash`](/docs/models/gemini-2.5-flash) is
  [deprecated](/docs/deprecations#gemini-2.5-flash-models) and is no longer
  available to select in Google AI Studio. Effective December 1, 2026, all API
  requests to `gemini-2.5-flash` will automatically route to
  [`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`](/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash-lite) and be billed
  at [Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates](/docs/pricing#gemini-3.5-flash-lite).
  Before December 1, 2026, update your model string to `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`
  and review the
  [Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite migration guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6#migrate-to-gemini-3-5-flash-lite).
  Breaking API changes include function calling and `thought_signature`
  validation, `thinking_level` replacing `thinking_budget`, and removed
  sampling parameters and prefilled model turns.

*   Released `gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025`, a new native audio
  model for the Live API. This update improves the model's ability to handle
  complex workflows. To learn more, see the [Live API
  guide](/docs/live-api/capabilities) and [Gemini 2.5 Flash Native
  Audio](/docs/models/gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025).

*   Launched enhancements to our [text-to-speech
  models](/docs/speech-generation), Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS preview (optimized
  for low latency) and Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS preview (optimized for quality),
  including enhanced expressivity, precision pacing, and seamless dialogue.

*     For [Gemini 2.5 Flash Image](/docs/image-generation), the input token count
  for images has been reduced from 1290 to 258, lowering the cost of image
  editing.
*   Launched Gemini 2.5 Flash Image GA: [Image Generation with Gemini](/docs/image-generation)

*   Released `gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-09-2025`, a new native audio
  model for the Live API with improved function calling and speech cut off
  handling. To learn more, see the [Live API
  guide](/docs/live-api/capabilities) and [Gemini 2.5 Flash Native
  Audio](/docs/models).

*     Released `gemini-2.5-flash`, our first stable 2.5 Flash model. To learn
  more, see [Gemini 2.5 Flash](/docs/models#gemini-25-flash).
  `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17` will be deprecated on July 15, 2025.

*     Released `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-05-20`, a Gemini
  [preview](/docs/models#model-versions) model optimized for price-performance
  and adaptive thinking. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5 Flash
  Preview](/docs/models) and
  [Thinking](/docs/thinking).

*     Released `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-native-audio-dialog` and
  `gemini-2.5-flash-exp-native-audio-thinking-dialog`, new Gemini models for
  the Live API with native audio output capabilities. To learn more, see the
  [Live API guide](/docs/live-api/capabilities#native-audio-output) and
  [Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio](/docs/models).

*   Released `gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17`, a Gemini
  [preview](/docs/models#model-versions) model optimized for price-performance
  and adaptive thinking. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5 Flash
  Preview](/docs/models) and
  [Thinking](/docs/thinking).
